# BINDING TEXT (Ed, 2026-09-25): battery float is MANDATORY for every measurement window; anything germane to the verity of the science is mandatory

**Ed's words:** "make it binding obviously anything germane to the verity of the science is mandatory"

**1. The battery gate, for every measurement window** (W1/W2, calibration, evidence and claim-bearing windows; not only W1):
- **At arm and immediately before publication/t0**, read `ioreg -r -c AppleSmartBattery` and require:
  - `ExternalConnected = Yes`;
  - `IsCharging = No`;
  - |InstantAmperage| ≤ 200 mA (two's complement handled).
- **Log** the raw values to the stage and the arm record.
- **Failure postpones the arm.** It is never waived.
- **Harvest check:** if any slot records `is_charging = true`, or its battery current exceeds the bound, the window is confounded and not used for any claim or acceptance. The arm notice and the harvest record say so.
- **The code-level t0 gate (BATTERY-FLOAT-GATE-01)** remains a full-gate lane and should land promptly. Until it does, the procedural check above is mandatory.

**2. The general principle, binding on all roles.** A check, disclosure or gate that bears on whether a measured or claimed number is TRUE is mandatory. It is not at the magistrate's discretion and not traded against schedule. Examples: instrument state, machine quietness, clock anchoring, calibration binding, contamination, and the statistical adequacy of a claim rule. Discretion applies only to things that cannot change a number (ceremony, docs, bookkeeping; see #415). When in doubt, treat the item as germane.

**Context:** issue #420. Ed changed the charge setting from an 80 % cap to 100 % on 2026-09-25, and the battery charged all afternoon. Charging adds heat (SoC temperature and leakage) and invalidates wall-meter readings.
title: Directive (Ed, 2026-09-25): battery-float gate mandatory for every window; anything germane to the verity of the science is mandatory

# BINDING TEXT (Ed, 2026-09-25): STOP asking Ed to turn off macOS automatic updates. The request is retired.

**Ed's words:** "i keep getting emailed about turning auto updates off - can you fix that persistent reminder". Earlier the same day: "I don't think auto updates are on or ever were on in the first place. I updated Mac OS because I didn't even think about how it might affect the instrument."

**Verified by the agent, 2026-09-25 (interactive 4b), read-only:**
- `/Library/Preferences/com.apple.SoftwareUpdate` has **no `AutomaticallyInstallMacOSUpdates` key**: macOS updates are **not** installed automatically.
- Its `DoItLaterTonightAttemptsCount` history shows past "install tonight" offers that were deferred. The 25F84 → 25G83 change was Ed's manual update, not an automatic one.
- Still on: `AutomaticDownload = 1` (updates download in the background, and **a download does not change the OS build**), "Automatic checking" on, and App Store app auto-update (`com.apple.commerce AutoUpdate = 1`). None of these changes the OS build under measurement.

**What to apply:**
1. No email, notice, arm notice, record or owner-blocker list may ask Ed to turn off automatic updates again. Remove the item from RUN_STATE's owner-blocker lists and from any notice template.
2. The instrument's protection against a build change is **mechanical**, and needs no owner action:
   - the calibration binds `os_build` and the powermetrics sha;
   - the arm-time cadence probe and the build binding refuse a mismatched build.

   If a build change is ever detected, report it once, as a finding, and never re-ask as a standing request.
3. Optional, Ed's choice, never to be re-asked: turn off "Download new updates when available" (System Settings → General → Software Update → Automatic updates ⓘ). The only purpose would be keeping background download traffic out of windows; the quiet census already catches heavy CPU.
title: Directive (Ed, 2026-09-25): stop asking Ed to turn off auto-updates — macOS OS updates are not auto-installed (verified); request retired

# BINDING TEXT (amended by Ed, 2026-09-25): the audit runs AFTER W1/W2 pass and BEFORE any claim-bearing run. It is NOT a W1 arm precondition.

**AMENDMENT (Ed, 2026-09-25, interactive 4b): "agreed with your proposed change of order".**

The three-family full-system audit moves from "before W1" to **after W1 and W2 pass and before any claim-bearing run**:
1. **Before W1:** no full audit. The acceptance PRs pass their normal full gates, and each arm runs its cadence probe.
2. **After W1/W2 pass, before any claim-bearing (headline) run:** the #416 audit at the frozen head that will produce paper numbers. Its evidence includes the real W1/W2 bundles, from which the auditors independently re-derive the calibration from raw data.
3. **If the audit finds a defect in the calibration derivation path,** W1/W2 are re-run before any headline run.

**Rationale.**
- Passing windows are internal-consistency evidence, not correctness evidence (silent-wrong paths pass by definition). So the audit remains mandatory.
- Real bundles let the auditors check numbers, not only code.
- Live-only defects surface in real windows.
- The headline pipeline is not frozen yet.
- A flawed W1/W2 costs about a day to redo; a flawed headline run costs the paper.

The trigger message becomes "CLAIM-RUN WORK COMPLETE" (W1/W2 issued plus the headline pipeline frozen), carrying the sha and scope. The kit (main `docs/process_traces/2026-09-24-interactive-4b/30-prearm-audit-kit-416.md`) is unchanged, except that its scope adds the W1/W2 bundles.

---

## Original text (superseded on placement only; scope, seats and method still apply)

Ed, 2026-09-25 (interactive session 4b): "i want a full multi agent fresh audit of the whole measurement system/codebase by astra 6 xhigh, fable 5.1 xhigh, and opus 5.5 xhigh". Clarified: "that's meant for when all the work before launching the load bearing windows" is done.

**The ruling. A pre-arm audit gate for the first load-bearing windows (W1/W2 of the 25G83 derivation, and every later claim-bearing window).**
1. **When.** After every pre-window change has merged (PR-L, PR-R, the sealed Revision 5, and anything else on the W1 critical path), and **before W1 is armed**.
2. **What.** A fresh, independent audit of the whole measurement system at the exact head W1 will run: instrument adapters, calibration and issuance, the night machinery (prepare, install, t0 census, driver, harvest), reduction, analysis and claim code.
3. **Who.** Three families, each at the highest effort available: Astra 6 at xhigh, Fable 5.1, and Opus 5.5 at xhigh. They audit independently and blind to one another. Their findings are cross-verified, and BLOCKERs get refuters from a different family.
4. **Outcome.** W1 arms only after every verified BLOCKER is fixed (under the gates for its tier) or ruled not load-bearing by a cold gate. The audit record is linked from the W1 arm notice.
5. **Timing is Ed's call.** The audit adds hours before W1. Ed accepts that.

**Who runs it.** Interactive seat 4b, if it is alive at that point. Otherwise the magistrate runs it. The magistrate signals "pre-window work complete" with the frozen head.
title: Directive (Ed, 2026-09-25, amended): fresh three-family full-system audit (Astra 6 xhigh, Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5 xhigh) after W1/W2 pass and before any claim-bearing run
